title: Retry On Fail + paid API = paid twice (Idempotency-Key)
brief_snippet: Learned this the expensive way. Retry On Fail on the HTTP Request node can’t tell whether the first request got through and only the response was lost. With a paid API (render, TTS, LLM, whatever) that means the job runs twice and you pay twice.   If the API takes an  Idempotency-Key  header, set it to    {{ $execution.id }}-{{ $itemIndex }}     both parts, not just the execution id.
